set.body: After the Double kernel-view and compatibility gates are resolved, build a nonproduction Ravel-backed Gale dense-storage prototype that preserves DVec and DMat as the public mathematical types. Compare it with the current Gale DoubleArray substrate on JVM and Scala.js. Acceptance criteria: exact semantic and ownership parity; matched indexing, slicing, transpose, dot, AXPY, GEMV, GEMM, builder, factorization-packing, and backend workloads; allocation and hidden-copy evidence; same-host timing receipts; and an explicit adopt-or-no-go conclusion. Production Gale storage must not change under this ticket.
set.title: Benchmark an experimental Ravel-backed Gale substrate
